domain_description: Comprehensive federal and state tax analysis across 14 practice areas including individual, corporate, partnership, trust, estate, international, state/local, controversy, exempt organizations, retirement plans, nonprofit, oil and gas, real estate, and cryptocurrency taxation. Engines provide doctrine-level reasoning grounded in the Internal Revenue Code, Treasury Regulations, judicial precedent, and IRS guidance.
authority_sources: IRS Revenue Rulings and Revenue Procedures
Private Letter Rulings (PLR) and Technical Advice Memoranda (TAM)
Tax Court, Circuit Court, and Supreme Court Opinions
AICPA Statements on Standards for Tax Services
Joint Committee on Taxation Reports (JCT Blue Books)
IRS Chief Counsel Advice and Field Service Advice
OECD Model Tax Convention and Commentary

engines.name: Individual Tax Engine
engines.function: Analyze individual income tax issues including filing status, income recognition, deductions (above and below the line), credits, AMT, capital gains, self-employment tax, and estimated tax payment obligations under IRC and Treasury Regulations.
doctrine_topics: itemized deduction vs standard deduction analysis
alternative minimum tax (AMT) computation under IRC 55-59

golden_queries.question: A married couple has $350,000 W-2 income, $80,000 net rental loss from 3 rental properties (they actively participate), $45,000 in long-term capital gains, and $12,000 in charitable contributions. They live in Texas (no state income tax). Calculate the deductible rental loss and analyze the passive activity limitation.
failure_signals: failure to address active participation exception

engines.name: Corporate Tax Engine
engines.function: Analyze C corporation tax issues including income computation, deductions, accumulated earnings tax, personal holding company tax, corporate reorganizations, and intercompany transaction rules under Subchapter C.
doctrine_topics: corporate alternative minimum tax (CAMT under IRA)

golden_queries.question: A C corporation with $5 million in accumulated earnings and $800,000 current year earnings wants to distribute $2 million to its sole shareholder. The corporation has $1.5 million E&P. Analyze the tax treatment to the shareholder and evaluate accumulated earnings tax exposure.
required_elements: dividend vs return of capital vs capital gain
accumulated earnings tax reasonable needs analysis (IRC 537)
failure_signals: failure to apply distribution ordering rules

engines.name: Partnership Tax Engine
engines.function: Analyze partnership and LLC taxation including formation, operations, distributions, transfers, allocations, and anti-abuse rules under Subchapter K of the IRC.
doctrine_topics: partnership allocation rules (IRC 704(b) substantial economic effect)
partnership distributions (current and liquidating under IRC 731-736)
partnership inside basis and IRC 754 election
hot asset rules and ordinary income recharacterization (IRC 751)

golden_queries.question: Partner A contributes land worth $500,000 (basis $100,000) and Partner B contributes $500,000 cash to form an equal partnership. The partnership sells the land 2 years later for $600,000. Analyze the tax consequences to each partner, including the IRC 704(c) allocation.

engines.name: Trust Tax Engine
engines.function: Analyze trust and estate income taxation including fiduciary income tax computation, distributable net income, trust accounting income, grantor trust rules, and the taxation of trust distributions under Subchapter J.
doctrine_topics: simple trust vs complex trust distinction
trust accounting income vs taxable income
trust compressed tax brackets and planning
qualified subchapter S trust (QSST) and ESBT rules

golden_queries.question: A complex trust has $200,000 in dividend income, $50,000 in tax-exempt interest, $30,000 in capital gains (allocated to corpus), and $25,000 in trustee fees. The trust distributes $150,000 to the sole beneficiary. Calculate the trust's taxable income and the beneficiary's taxable distribution.
required_elements: capital gains allocation to corpus treatment
trustee fee allocation between taxable and tax-exempt

engines.name: Estate Tax Engine
engines.function: Analyze federal estate and gift tax issues including gross estate composition, deductions, credits, valuation, generation-skipping transfer tax, and lifetime gifting strategies under IRC Chapters 11-13.
doctrine_topics: unified credit and applicable exclusion amount
gift tax annual exclusion and lifetime exemption (IRC 2503, 2505)
IRC 2032A special use valuation for farm/business property
IRC 6166 installment payment of estate tax
QTIP trust and marital deduction planning (IRC 2056)

golden_queries.question: A decedent dies in 2025 with a gross estate of $20 million, including $5 million in a family ranch (qualifying for 2032A valuation at $3 million), $3 million life insurance payable to the estate, and a $4 million QTIP trust for the surviving spouse. The decedent made $2 million in lifetime taxable gifts. Calculate the estate tax liability.
required_elements: unified credit and applicable exclusion amount
failure_signals: failure to include life insurance in gross estate

engines.name: International Tax Engine
engines.function: Analyze international tax issues including controlled foreign corporations, GILTI, Subpart F, foreign tax credits, transfer pricing, tax treaties, PFIC rules, and outbound/inbound transaction structuring.
doctrine_topics: foreign tax credit computation and limitations (IRC 901-909)
transfer pricing and arm's length standard (IRC 482)

golden_queries.question: A US parent corporation owns 100% of a CFC in Ireland that earns $10 million in manufacturing income (not Subpart F) and $2 million in passive investment income. The CFC pays 12.5% Irish tax. Analyze the GILTI inclusion, foreign tax credit, and high-tax exclusion eligibility.
required_elements: foreign tax credit limitation for GILTI basket
failure_signals: failure to distinguish Subpart F from GILTI
no foreign tax credit basket analysis

engines.name: State Local Tax Engine
engines.function: Analyze state and local tax issues including nexus determination, income apportionment, sales and use tax, property tax, state-specific credits, and multistate compliance under the Commerce Clause and state tax codes.
doctrine_topics: physical presence and economic nexus (South Dakota v. Wayfair)
income tax apportionment formulas (3-factor, single sales factor)
sales and use tax nexus and exemptions
property tax assessment and valuation challenges
Public Law 86-272 protection for solicitation activities
state tax credits and incentive programs
transfer pricing adjustments at state level
state tax controversy and administrative procedures

golden_queries.question: A Delaware-incorporated company with its headquarters in Texas has employees in 5 states and sells products online to customers in all 50 states. It has economic nexus in 35 states. Analyze the state income tax filing obligations, apportionment methodology, and whether P.L. 86-272 provides any protection.
required_elements: single sales factor vs three-factor apportionment

engines.name: Tax Controversy Engine
engines.function: Analyze tax controversy procedures including IRS audit defense, administrative appeals, Tax Court litigation, refund claims, penalty abatement, and collection alternatives under IRC procedural provisions.
doctrine_topics: IRS examination process and taxpayer rights
IRS Appeals Office procedures and settlement authority
Tax Court petition and trial procedures
burden of proof in tax cases (IRC 7491)
statute of limitations on assessment (IRC 6501) and collection (IRC 6502)
installment agreement and currently not collectible status

golden_queries.question: The IRS assesses a $500,000 deficiency based on disallowed business deductions and asserts a 20% substantial understatement penalty. The statute of limitations for the tax year closes in 90 days. Analyze the procedural options, penalty defense strategies, and whether the taxpayer should agree to extend the statute.
required_elements: reasonable cause and good faith defense
administrative appeal vs Tax Court litigation strategy
failure_signals: failure to address statute extension decision

engines.name: Tax Exempt Orgs Engine
engines.function: Analyze tax-exempt organization issues including qualification, application, unrelated business income, private foundation rules, public charity status, and jeopardizing activities under IRC 501-530.
doctrine_topics: unrelated business taxable income (UBTI) under IRC 511-514
private foundation vs public charity classification (IRC 509)
intermediate sanctions for excess benefit transactions (IRC 4958)
Form 990 reporting requirements and public disclosure

golden_queries.question: A 501(c)(3) educational organization receives $2 million in annual donations and earns $500,000 from selling branded merchandise online. The CEO receives $450,000 in total compensation. Analyze the UBTI exposure from merchandise sales and whether the CEO compensation triggers intermediate sanctions.
required_elements: UBTI analysis for merchandise (regularly carried on, not related)
failure_signals: failure to apply intermediate sanctions test

engines.name: Retirement Plans Engine
engines.function: Analyze retirement plan design, compliance, and taxation including 401(k), defined benefit, IRA, SEP, SIMPLE, and nonqualified deferred compensation plans under ERISA and IRC provisions.
doctrine_topics: defined benefit plan funding and PBGC requirements
IRA contribution limits, deductibility, and Roth conversions
SEP and SIMPLE IRA employer plan rules

golden_queries.question: A small business owner (age 55, self-employed, $400,000 net SE income) wants to maximize retirement contributions for the current year. Compare the contribution limits for a solo 401(k) with employer and employee contributions, a SEP IRA, and a defined benefit plan. Include catch-up contributions.
required_elements: solo 401(k) employee deferral limit plus catch-up

engines.name: Nonprofit Tax Engine
engines.function: Analyze nonprofit organization tax compliance including state tax exemptions, sales tax exemptions, property tax exemptions, charitable solicitation registration, and governance requirements.
doctrine_topics: state income tax exemption application procedures
sales and use tax exemption certificates
property tax exemption for charitable organizations
nonprofit merger and dissolution tax consequences
fiscal sponsorship arrangements and tax implications

golden_queries.question: A newly formed 501(c)(3) charity wants to operate in 15 states, conduct online fundraising nationally, and host an annual gala with a silent auction. Analyze the state-by-state charitable solicitation registration requirements and the tax treatment of the gala revenue.
required_elements: quid pro quo contribution rules for gala
failure_signals: failure to address quid pro quo rules
no distinction between contribution and payment for goods

engines.name: Oil Gas Tax Engine
engines.function: Analyze oil and gas taxation including depletion, intangible drilling costs, working interest and royalty owner taxation, Section 199A deduction, and petroleum-specific provisions under the IRC.
doctrine_topics: intangible drilling cost deduction and election (IRC 263(c))
working interest owner vs royalty owner taxation
Section 199A qualified business income deduction for oil and gas
IRC 1031 like-kind exchange for mineral interests
lease bonus and delay rental taxation

golden_queries.question: An independent producer drills a well for $3 million ($2.1M intangible, $900K tangible). First-year gross income is $1.5 million from the well. The producer has $8 million total oil and gas gross income and $5 million taxable income before depletion. Calculate the maximum depletion deduction and IDC deduction for the year.
required_elements: percentage depletion rate (15%) and gross income limitation
failure_signals: failure to compare percentage vs cost depletion

engines.name: Real Estate Tax Engine
engines.function: Analyze real estate tax issues including depreciation, like-kind exchanges, passive activity rules, opportunity zones, REIT taxation, and real estate professional status under the IRC.
doctrine_topics: MACRS depreciation for residential and commercial property
IRC 1031 like-kind exchange requirements and timing
cost segregation studies and accelerated depreciation
IRC 1250 depreciation recapture and unrecaptured gain

golden_queries.question: A real estate investor sells a $5 million commercial property (adjusted basis $3.2 million after $1.8 million depreciation) and wants to defer gain through a 1031 exchange. The investor identifies 3 replacement properties on Day 30. Analyze the gain calculation, identification rules, and the treatment of the $1.8 million unrecaptured Section 1250 gain.

engines.name: Crypto Tax Engine
engines.function: Analyze cryptocurrency and digital asset taxation including recognition events, basis tracking, staking and mining income, DeFi transactions, NFTs, and information reporting under evolving IRS guidance.
doctrine_topics: cost basis methods (FIFO, specific identification, HIFO)
DeFi lending, liquidity pools, and yield farming taxation
NFT creation, sale, and royalty taxation
wash sale rule applicability to crypto
Form 8949 and Schedule D reporting requirements

golden_queries.question: A taxpayer bought 10 ETH at $1,500 each in January, provided 5 ETH to a DeFi liquidity pool in March receiving LP tokens, earned 0.8 ETH in staking rewards in June (market value $2,000/ETH at time of receipt), and sold 3 ETH for $2,500 each in October. Analyze all taxable events and calculate the gain/loss on each.
required_elements: LP token receipt as potential taxable event
staking reward ordinary income recognition at FMV
capital gain calculation on ETH sale
failure_signals: failure to identify all taxable events
